title: Hang-Ups
description: Everybody has their hang ups. Anticipating a date at his overly messy apartment, a man frantically cleans and rearranges everything in sight — and unravels when his date doesn't show by 7:00. A montage cut entirely to John Waters and Divine's "Female Trouble." Written, directed, and starring Jacob Willett, with Gabe Zendejas as DP, editor, and colorist — made on a budget under $200. One of two shorts, alongside DEFICIT, that got Jacob into SDSU's film production program.
